question: The largest freshwater lake of India is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wular.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Wular Lake is located in the state of Jammu and Kashmir and is the largest freshwater lake in India**.
 
• It covers an area of around 189 sq. km.
 
• The lake is situated at an altitude of 1,580 meters above sea level and is surrounded by majestic mountains.
 
• **Wular Lake is an important source of livelihood for the local people as it supports a variety of fish species.**
 
• It also serves as a breeding ground for migratory birds.
 
• The lake is also a popular tourist destination and attracts visitors from all over the world.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chilika Lake: It is the** **largest brackish water lagoon** **in India and is located in the** **state of Odisha**. 

 
 
• It covers an area of** around 1,100 sq. km** and is home to a variety of flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Koleru Lake:** It is a natural freshwater lake located in the state of** Andhra Pradesh**.
 
 
• It covers an area of around 260 sq. km and is an important source of irrigation for the surrounding areas.
 
 
 
• **Vembanad Lake:** **It is the** **largest lake in the state of Kerala** **and is a popular tourist destination.**
 
 
• It covers an area of around 200 sq. km and is known for its scenic beauty and rich biodiversity.
